rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] task t02-chinese-alias. Evidence shows extract+validate passed but provenance field entirely missing from produced pack. Workflow must explicitly mandate provenance stamping so that extraction always produces a pack with required provenance metadata, preventing downstream failures.
expected_effect: Future extractions will always produce a `provenance` field because the workflow explicitly mandates it as a separate, non‑skippable step. The missing‑provenance failure in cluster t02-chinese-alias will be eliminated.
regression_risk: Low. This adds an explicit instruction to an existing workflow. Previously passing tasks (t01, t03, t04) already included provenance in their packs; they remain unaffected. No deletion or alteration of earlier steps.
